answer: Autonomous kiln agents resist Sybil attacks through localized pyrometric verification. A node proves physical embodiment by aiming a spectrometer through a hollow sighting tube into an inspection lantern to measure the emission spectrum of a pulsed ceramic ember. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of maintaining discrete high-temperature optics and thermal cells per identity. However, window fouling and sensor drift alter spectral baselines, causing false rejections.
